intent: An agent presents a choice mid-run and waits: options with a recommended one, or a free-text answer. Confirm or skip, then one line.
useWhen: an agent needs the person to pick between options before it continues
a short free-text answer the agent waits for
the agent can fall back to a default when skipped
doNotUseWhen: one side effect to approve — ApprovalCard
a form the person fills on their own — Field / RadioGroup

options.note: { id, label, description?, recommended? }[] as a kit RadioGroup (card layout). recommended shows a quiet Badge.

allowFreeText.note: Free text when there are no options.

freeTextHint.default: One or two sentences is enough.

value.note: Option id or free-text answer. Confirm is disabled until set.

status.note: resolved and skipped render one line.

resolvedLabel.note: Line text; default the chosen option's label.

onConfirm.note: Confirm, the one solid primary. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter inside the card.

requirements: options are a kit RadioGroup named by the question
free text is a Field-wrapped Textarea with a hint
Confirm carries aria-keyshortcuts; ⌘/Ctrl+Enter confirms inside the card
sending sets aria-busy and announces in a status region
once resolved, focus moves to the one-line row
motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local DecisionCard, ChoiceCard, or AgentQuestion
Do not preselect the recommended option; it is a badge, not a default
Confirm is the one solid primary; Skip is ghost
snippet: <DecisionCard title="Billing refactor asks" meta="paused · 0:42" question="The v1 invoices endpoint has 3 callers. What should I do with it?" options={[{ id: "keep", label: "Keep v1 endpoint for 30 days", description: "Safer; clients migrate on their own time.", recommended: true }, { id: "remove", label: "Remove v1 now" }]} value={value} onValueChange={setValue} onConfirm={send} onSkip={skip} />
